skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply statistical index methods.
Analyze time series data and understand its components.
Apply simple forecasting methods based on time series data.
Understand and apply Box-Jenkins forecasting models.
Construct and estimate time series regression models.
Construct and evaluate Vector Autoregression (VAR) models.
Collect data suitable for statistical analysis and forecasting.
Evaluate statistical models and forecast results using appropriate tests.
Apply theoretical knowledge to solve economic, management, and business administration problems.
Develop critical thinking skills in choosing topics and solving problems.
Work collaboratively in groups to complete assignments and projects.
Demonstrate self-learning abilities by independently studying materials and applying concepts.
Use EViews software to perform practical exercises with real-world datasets.
